blocks.text: Architecting a Smart Portal to Extend ERP Functionality and Reduce Costs
Information Technology
Client
A large engineering and IT services provider working on a project for a major manufacturer of heavy electrical equipment.
Ambition
To extend critical ERP workflows to a wider group of users without incurring the prohibitively high cost of additional ERP licenses.
Outcome
Architected and built a custom portal solution that leveraged existing investments to provide seamless, integrated access to ERP workflows, saving significant licensing costs.
The Ambition
A large engineering and IT services provider working on a project for a major manufacturer of heavy electrical equipment.
The Challenge

The core challenge was cost. While their SAP ERP was a powerful and essential system, deploying full licenses to every user who needed occasional access to specific workflows was not financially feasible. They had made a significant investment in a separate collaboration platform (SharePoint) but lacked a way to integrate the two systems to solve this business problem.
The Architectural Blueprint

The client's ambition was to improve collaboration and efficiency by extending key specification and costing workflows from their core SAP system to additional users. They needed a solution that could achieve this business goal in a highly cost-effective manner, avoiding millions in potential software licensing fees.
Ambition, Realized

The integrated portal was a significant win, delivering the full required business functionality at a minimal incremental cost. The solution successfully broke down the technology silos, allowing the client to leverage their existing investments to solve a critical business need. Multiple complex approval processes were automated, enhancing team productivity. Most importantly, this was achieved without impacting the uptime of their mission-critical production ERP system.
Key Business Impact
Saved Significant Costs on ERP Licensing
Maximized ROI on Existing Technology Investments
Seamlessly Integrated Disparate Enterprise Systems
Automated Complex Workflows for Enhanced Productivity
